scenario: four-step tracked CPL3 SYSCALL to CPL0 store to SYSRETQ to CPL3 load

roundtrip_scenario.aliases: fixture maps the same physical qword as supervisor RW and user RO

profile.single_page_boundaries: each instruction fetch and qword operand fits within one guest page
profile.debug_flags: each step requires live TF=0 and RF=0; SYSRETQ rejects saved R11.TF

verification.review_probe: separate machine-level probe confirmed saved-R11.TF rejection retains exact fetch A-bit update and committed_write callback; not included in the 33-test target

boundaries: not a general syscall ABI or Linux entry path
no TSS/IST or stack switch, SWAPGS, compatibility SYSRET, WRMSR, async event delivery or CPL3 exception delivery
cross-page instruction fetch and qword operand are unsupported
initial CPL3 state is supplied by a synthetic fixture
parent S4-20 and Stage 4 remain open
architecture_source: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B SYSCALL/SYSRET and Vol. 3A system state; https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html
